nf986b206bc.headline: Argentine Scientists and an Advance That Would Improve Cancer Treatment | El Dia
nf986b206bc.summary: Researchers from the Leloir Institute and Conicet found that certain drugs blocking DNA replication in malignant cells may benefit therapies for breast, colon, liver, and blood cancers.
nf986b206bc.why: Medical research breakthroughs can lead to new therapies, impacting pharmaceutical companies and healthcare sectors.
